question: Can one exact Research 0250 recovery receipt be atomically applied to the unchanged pending ledger as a completed or separately versioned bounded-cancellation terminal, while replay, conflict and insufficient evidence remain non-authorizing?
objects_and_types: Canonical project-original pending ledgers, exact pending-effect-witness-receipt-v0 values produced by the pinned Research 0250 receiver, and one recovery-resolution-ledger-v0 terminal written by same-directory atomic replacement under an exclusive local lock.
quantifiers: Sixteen bounded tool processes: six read-only parent receiver processes and ten application processes covering positive completion, bounded cancellation, exact replays, insufficient evidence, wrong context, post-replace process exit, and two-process contradictory-receipt contention on a new instance.
candidate_grammar: EffectWitnessVerified maps pending to completed. NoEffectWitnessVerified maps pending to a separately typed cancelled terminal that retains the exact channel and closed interval and grants no retry. Unknown or invalid parent outcomes do not mutate. A byte-identical receipt after a terminal is ReplayRefused; a distinct receipt for the same terminal context is ConflictRefused. Context substitution is InvalidContext.
evaluation: Exactly one transition is committed per ledger. Replays and conflicts leave terminal bytes unchanged; insufficient and wrong-context inputs leave pending bytes unchanged; a process exit after durable replacement leaves a terminal that refuses replay; concurrent contradictory receipts produce one terminal and one refusal. No target process starts and all authority flags remain false.
exit: Stop on the first pin, process, output, state, atomicity, classification, accounting or resource failure. At most one implementation-correction replay is permitted. Never launch a target, infer global nonoccurrence, refund, authorize retry or rewrite frozen parent evidence.
protected: Completed and bounded-cancelled are distinct terminal states
Cancelled retains the exact finite channel and interval and is not global nonoccurrence
Cancelled grants no retry or refund authority
Unknown and invalid parent outcomes cannot mutate pending
Exact replay is refused rather than counted as another application
A durable terminal survives absence of an application stdout receipt
No native free, Close, M6 or arithmetic-universality claim
